summary: Completed frontend testing of MeetingRoom.jsx refactored components (VideoControls, ParticipantGrid, MeetingPanels). All 9 test cases passed: Portal selector navigation, AI KARAU Meeting login, dashboard access, create new meeting, join meeting room with VideoControls rendering, ParticipantGrid displaying local user, control buttons (mute/video/screen share/raise hand), side panel toggles (chat/participants/AI notes/settings), and leave meeting functionality.

issues: Dialog overlay intercepts clicks - requires force=True for button clicks (minor UX issue)

critical_code_review_comments: MeetingRoom.jsx successfully refactored from ~1459 lines to ~795 lines
VideoControls.jsx properly implements all control buttons with data-testid attributes
ParticipantGrid.jsx correctly displays local user video tile with avatar fallback
MeetingPanels.jsx (ChatPanel, AINotesPanel, ParticipantsPanel, SettingsPanel) all render correctly
All data-testid attributes present: control-audio, control-video, control-screen-share, control-raise-hand, control-chat, control-participants, control-ai-notes, control-settings, control-leave
Settings panel includes toggles for AI Transcription, Auto-generate Summary, Noise Cancellation, HD Video
